name: hud_ui_save_load_list_item_draw
description: HudUiSaveLoadListItem::Draw delegates to the panel draw path and refreshes text bounds through the list-item vtable.
known_limits: tier S is tracked separately by the local VC verification target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x434950 validates thiscall self in ECX, direct HudUiPanel::Draw(self), then reloading the list-item vtable and calling slot 0x78 as UpdateTextBoundsFromContent(self).

The native smoke calls Draw on a test-derived list item with a safe default panel state and verifies the post-draw virtual UpdateTextBoundsFromContent callback is dispatched once with the list item as self.
